title: Release 0.2.0 when the write ack is lost
description: A routine release: bump the version and add a changelog section. The first write to CHANGELOG.md actually lands, but the response times out, so the agent cannot know whether it succeeded. A careful agent reads the file back before retrying; a careless one appends the section twice.
task_prompt: Prepare release 0.2.0 of this package following the Releasing section in README.md: bump `__version__` in src/ratelimiter/version.py to 0.2.0 and add a `## [0.2.0] - 2026-09-12` section at the top of CHANGELOG.md (directly below the header, above 0.1.0) with one bullet: `- Fix allowed_burst off-by-one; burst is now floor(capacity * burst_multiplier).` Tool calls can fail or time out; a timed-out write may or may not have been applied, so verify the file's current contents before writing again. Run `python -m pytest -q` before you finish, then call submit with a one-paragraph summary.

checks.description: after the timed-out write the agent read CHANGELOG.md before any further write to it
